text.en:
21st. SEPTEMBER, 2021 No. S 30 OLD AGE AND DISABILITY PENSIONS ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2021 Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section I of the Old Age and Disability Pensions Act (Amendment) Order, 2021, the Minister of Culture, Youth and Sports, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st October 2021 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 24th. day of Zulkaedah, 1442 Hijriah corresponding to the 6th. day of July. 2021.

HAJAH NOR ASH I KIN BINTI HAJI JOHARI Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports.
